make_or_buy_basis: Replaceable cameras and intercoms use keyed connectors and common adapters while preserving coverage, privacy and accessible call locations.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: cleanable tamper-resistant passenger finish, sealed penetrations, galvanic/electrical isolation and protected labels
material_spec.form_factor: plug-in line-replaceable modules with labelled connectors, strain relief, bend-radius/service loops and no hidden joints behind fixed trim
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail electronics specification plus project fire/smoke, EMC, IP, cybersecurity/configuration, accessibility and lifecycle evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: serialised display/camera/intercom/audio modules, keyed power/data connectors, fire-rated harness tails, common-rail adapters and captive service fasteners
material_spec.nominal_section: field of view/visibility/reach, mounting envelope, connector keying, heat rejection and service clearance fixed by LM3-INT-230 interface drawings
material_spec.traceability: equipment serial, hardware/firmware/configuration revision, harness batch, adapter position, network address and functional-test record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: SOURCE supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Exact display, camera, amplifier, intercom, recorder and software licences remain to be selected.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Use open Ethernet/IP interfaces and OSR mounting adapters so displays, cameras, audio and intercoms can be substituted individually after EMC, cybersecurity, accessibility and system regression tests.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: rail passenger information, video and communication systems
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
